prompt.zh-TW: 暖木家具要和晨光印刷簽三年的包裝印刷合約，先付一筆預付款。採購經理美玲拿到晨光的財報，只有時間先看一件事。如果你是客戶，會先確認什麼？
prompt.en: Warm Timber Furniture is about to sign a three-year packaging contract with Morning Light Printing and pay a deposit up front. Purchasing manager Mei-ling has Morning Light’s statements but time to check only one thing first. As the customer, what would you confirm first?

text.zh-TW: 短期償債能力：流動比率與現金是否充足
text.en: Liquidity: the current ratio and whether cash is adequate

upside.zh-TW: 預付款最怕供應商倒閉；短期付得出錢的公司，三年內突然停擺的機率較低。
upside.en: The deposit’s biggest risk is the supplier failing; a company that can pay its short-term bills is less likely to shut down suddenly.

downside.zh-TW: 短期流動性好不代表長期有競爭力，品質與交期還是要另外評估。
downside.en: Good short-term liquidity does not guarantee long-term competitiveness; quality and delivery still need separate assessment.

text.zh-TW: 獲利是否穩定：最近幾年的淨利有沒有大起大落
text.en: Whether profit is stable: have recent years’ results swung widely

upside.zh-TW: 穩定獲利的供應商比較有能力投資設備、留住人才，三年的合作比較可靠。
upside.en: A steadily profitable supplier is better able to invest in equipment and keep staff, making a three-year relationship more reliable.

downside.zh-TW: 獲利穩定的公司也可能因為現金週轉不過來而出問題；獲利不等於現金。
downside.en: A steadily profitable company can still run into trouble through poor cash management; profit is not cash.

text.zh-TW: 負債與資金結構：借了多少錢、什麼時候到期
text.en: Debt and funding structure: how much is borrowed and when it falls due

upside.zh-TW: 負債很重、集中在近期到期的供應商，一旦銀行抽銀根就可能停工，客戶會被牽連。
upside.en: A heavily indebted supplier with debt maturing soon may halt production if the bank pulls back, dragging customers down with it.

downside.zh-TW: 負債高不一定危險，要配合獲利與現金一起看；單看這一項容易誤判。
downside.en: High debt is not necessarily dangerous; it has to be read with profit and cash, and on its own it can mislead.

viewpoint.zh-TW: 客戶也是利害關係人：預付款、備料與整條供應鏈都押在供應商能不能持續經營上，所以客戶看供應商的財報，重點是「它會不會在合約期內出事」。三個角度分別對應倒閉的三種前兆：短期付不出錢、本業長期不賺錢、債務壓垮。先看哪一個，取決於你的預付款有多大、替代供應商有多難找。
viewpoint.en: Customers are stakeholders too: deposits, materials and the whole supply chain depend on the supplier staying in business, so a customer reads a supplier’s statements to ask whether it will get into trouble during the contract. The three angles match three warning signs of failure: inability to pay in the short term, a core business that does not earn, and crushing debt. Which to check first depends on how large your deposit is and how hard a substitute supplier would be to find.

explanation.zh-TW: 這一題沒有標準答案；送出之後會看到三個做法各自的理由。
explanation.en: There is no single right answer here; once you submit, you will see the reasoning behind all three choices.
